text:
Priya M: Quick idea — propose a compact 72h postmortem follow-up template + incident commander rotation rules. Keep it light, please react with :eyes: if you want to iterate.
Sam O: SGTM. can you sketch the template?
Priya M: Sure, rough draft below. Goal: actionable owners, dates, short blocking status. Use in-retro and 72h check-in.
Priya M: ```72h-checkin-template
- Incident ID: <INC-XXXX>
- Summary: 1-liner
- Severity & Impact: brief
- Owner(s): IC, Remediation owner, QA owner
- 24h: actions (owner, due)
- 72h: status (done/in-progress/blocked), blockers, next step
- Follow-ups: assigned tickets + due dates
- Recurrence flags: <yes/no> + recurrence detail
```
Kai L: Love the clarity. Suggest adding a couple small fields: "Rollback risk" and "Customer impact note" so prioritization is obvious.
Jess F: Also propose a simple rotation: IC = oncall primary for 8h, backup = platform volunteer; if incident >6h, plan for 12h handoffs. Keep it pragmatic and documented in the thread.
Sam O: Can we add an auto-reminder flow? IncidentBot should ping remediation owners at 24h & 72h with status template.
IncidentBot: scheduled reminder queued -> ping @RemediationOwner at 2951234240 (simulated)
Priya M: Thanks — I'll land this into a lightweight doc and run a 2-week pilot starting Monday. Volunteers for the first rotation?
Kai L: I'll take week 1.
Jess F: I'll do week 2.
Sam O: I'll help instrument the IncidentBot reminders and add a tiny dashboard metric for "follow-up lag". Quick follow-up ask: can we do a 4-pilot retro to see if this reduces reopen/recurrence signals?
Priya M: Yup — quick retro after 4 cycles, short agenda: what saved time, what added overhead, any blind spots. If no objections I'll post the doc to #eng-playbooks and CC SRE leads.
Sam O: :thumbsup: 
Jess F: :raised_hands:
